description:
The short winning price for an agent, paid per call, with no account: the full summary and up to 10 items.
One fifth of the `GET /api/precos/detalhe` report, at the same price per part: the free summary, the full summary (lowest, highest, average, discount and small-business share) and up to 10 items, sold per call to agents, with no account, no allowance and no plan. Who wins, who buys and the distribution by state, month and size are in the full report (`detalhe`), at the person's price, with x402 or credit. A request without payment gets the 402 with the price; a paid one gets the response in the same call, with the payment in `cobranca`. The query runs before settlement: a refused term and an unavailable origin return the error, with no charge.

catmat.description: Item code in the government catalog, up to 64 characters.

compra.description: Procurement id in the collection: the quantity comes from its item, in the compared group. An item in a package without the count (`Embalagem FL`) does not count: the unit does not say how many sheets.

produto.description: Catalog product, as in `grupos` (up to 80 letters); without it, the largest group.

q.description: Item description; at least 3 letters, up to 200.

quantidade.description: How much you will sell, in the group unit: the price of the range of that quantity.

uf.description: State (UF) abbreviation of the buying agency.
